newsitem.title: USA: Maxwell House ups price on 13 oz can coffee.
newsitem.headline: Maxwell House ups price on 13 oz can coffee.

text.p: A spokeswoman for Maxwell House Coffee Co, a division of Philip Morris' Kraft Foods, said on Tuesday the company will raise the list price on its standard 13-ounce cans of regular and decaffeinated ground coffees by 30 cents due to higher prices of green coffee on the world's futures markets.
The increase, which is to take effect immediately, brings the new price for a standard can of regular ground coffee to $3.36, and decaffeinated ground Maxwell House to $4.06, the spokeswoman said.
The Maxwell House price hike comes one day after Procter & Gamble Co unit Folgers Coffee Co announced an identical price increase.
Since February, both roasters -- the two largest in the U.S. -- have boosted the list price on 13 oz cans of ground coffee by $1.10 -- or almost 49 percent.
The spokeswoman said the company also raised the price of Maxwell House Instant Coffee by 1.25 cents an ounce, taking the list price up to $3.96 for the 8-ounce size.
The price for Maxwell House single packets of coffee, General Foods International flavored coffees and Maxwell House Cappucino, however, will remain the same, she said.
